headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 6, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies in a 15-1 victory, led by Tyler Tolbert's 5 hits, including a home run. Noah Cameron earned the win with 5 strong innings, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run. In other action, the New York Yankees secured a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with José Caballero hitting 2 home runs and driving in 4 runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Max Rajcic of the St. Louis Cardinals, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness. The Atlanta Braves have also placed Martín Pérez on the 15-day injured list with a left forearm contusion, while Brandon Woodruff of the Milwaukee Brewers is out with right shoulder inflammation.

The New York Mets made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers. The deal was made for cash considerations.

top_news.title: **Royals Rout Phillies 15-1**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dominated the Philadelphia Phillies in a lopsided 15-1 victory. Tyler Tolbert led the Royals' offense with 5 hits, including a home run, while Noah Cameron earned the win with 5 strong innings, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Rays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, led by José Caballero's impressive performance at the plate. Caballero hit 2 home runs and drove in 4 runs, while Cam Schlittler pitched 8 strong innings with 8 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall Short in Thrilling 11-12 Loss to Nationals**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals edged out the Houston Astros 11-12 in a high-scoring game, with CJ Abrams leading the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Enyel De Los Santos pitched a strong 1.0 inning in relief, striking out 2 batters without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Thrilling 7-6 Win Over Braves**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets edged out the Atlanta Braves in a close game, securing a 7-6 victory. Matt Olson led the Braves' offense with 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals' Rajcic Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: St. Louis Cardinals right-handed pitcher Max Rajcic has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow soreness, effective retroactive to July 4, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers. The deal was made for cash considerations.
